title: Entangle 2 Qubits
description: Use quantum gates to create a Bell state with 2 qubits. Start by putting the first qubit in superposition, then entangle it with the second qubit using a controlled gate.

title: Simple X Gate
description: Apply a Pauli-X gate to flip a single qubit from |0⟩ to |1⟩ state. The X gate is the quantum equivalent of a classical NOT gate.

title: Superposition with H Gate
description: Put a single qubit into superposition using the Hadamard gate. After applying H to qubit 0, it will be in an equal mix of |0⟩ and |1⟩.

title: Flip to |1⟩ with Z Gate
description: Start by flipping qubit 0 to |1⟩ using X gate, then apply the Z gate. The Z gate applies a phase flip — on |1⟩ it gives −|1⟩.

title: Apply Y Gate
description: Apply the Pauli-Y gate to qubit 0. The Y gate combines both a bit flip and a phase flip, rotating the qubit state on the Bloch sphere around the Y-axis.

title: Double Flip = Identity
description: Apply the X gate twice on qubit 0. Applying X two times returns the qubit to its original state — showing that X is its own inverse.

title: H Then X Then H
description: Apply H, then X, then H again on qubit 0. This sandwich (H·X·H) is equivalent to the Z gate — a key identity in quantum computing!

title: CNOT with Control on Q1
description: Apply a CNOT gate where qubit 1 is the control and qubit 0 is the target. This is the reverse of the standard Bell state circuit.

title: Phase Flip with S Gate
description: Apply the Hadamard gate to qubit 0 to create equal superposition, then apply the S gate. The S gate adds a phase of π/2 (+i) to the |1⟩ component.

title: T Gate π/4 Rotation
description: Put qubit 0 into superposition with H, then apply the T gate. The T gate is the π/4 phase gate (square root of S), crucial for universal quantum computation.

title: Parallel Bit Flips (X ⊗ X)
description: Apply an X gate on qubit 0 and an X gate on qubit 1. This flips both qubits simultaneously from |00⟩ into the |11⟩ state.

title: 2-Qubit Superposition (H ⊗ H)
description: Apply the Hadamard gate on qubit 0 and on qubit 1. This creates a uniform superposition of all 4 basis states: (|00⟩ + |01⟩ + |10⟩ + |11⟩)/2.

title: Invert Superposition to |-⟩
description: Prepare the |+⟩ state by applying H on qubit 0, then apply Z. The Pauli-Z gate flips the sign of |1⟩, turning |+⟩ into |−⟩ = (|0⟩ - |1⟩)/√2.

title: Triple X Gate Flips
description: Apply the X gate 3 times in sequence on qubit 0. Because X·X = I, three successive flips result in a net single NOT flip, leaving the qubit in |1⟩.

title: Bit-Flip via Pauli-Y
description: Apply the Pauli-Y gate to qubit 0 followed by the Pauli-Z gate. This maps the state through the Bloch sphere back to |1⟩ with a global phase.

title: Hadamard Identity (H · H)
description: Apply the Hadamard gate twice in succession on qubit 0. Because H is its own inverse (H = H†), the state is placed in superposition and then brought back to |0⟩.

title: S Gate Squared = Z Gate
description: Apply the S gate twice in series on qubit 0 after flipping it to |1⟩ with an X gate. Since S = √Z, two S gates apply an exact π phase flip identical to Z.

title: Prepare the |+i⟩ State
description: Put qubit 0 into equal superposition using the Hadamard gate, then apply the S gate. This creates the eigenstate of Pauli-Y: |+i⟩ = (|0⟩ + i|1⟩)/√2.

title: Two-Qubit State SWAP
description: Flip qubit 0 to |1⟩ using an X gate, then apply a SWAP gate between qubit 0 and qubit 1. Qubit 1 will become |1⟩ and qubit 0 will return to |0⟩.

title: Phase Inversion on 2 Qubits
description: Apply Hadamard on both qubit 0 and qubit 1 to create an equal superposition of 4 basis states, then apply a Z gate on qubit 0 to flip signs.

title: Bell State |Φ+⟩ Entanglement
description: Construct the canonical Bell state |Φ+⟩ = (|00⟩ + |11⟩)/√2 using 2 qubit lines. Put qubit 0 into superposition with H, then entangle it with qubit 1 using a CNOT gate.

title: 3-Qubit GHZ State Entanglement
description: Create a Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state (|000⟩ + |111⟩)/√2 across 3 qubit lines. Start by putting qubit 0 in superposition with H, then entangle qubit 0 with qubit 1 and qubit 2 using CNOT gates.

title: Bell State |Ψ+⟩ (Bit-Flip Entanglement)
description: Create the Bell state |Ψ+⟩ = (|01⟩ + |10⟩)/√2 using 2 qubit lines. Apply X to qubit 1 to flip it to |1⟩, apply H to qubit 0 to create superposition, then entangle with CNOT (control on q0, target on q1).

title: Bell State |Φ-⟩ (Phase-Flip Entanglement)
description: Create the Bell state |Φ-⟩ = (|00⟩ - |11⟩)/√2 using 2 qubit lines. Apply X to qubit 0, then apply H to qubit 0 to prepare the |−⟩ state, then entangle with CNOT (control on q0, target on q1).

title: Bell State |Ψ-⟩ (Singlet Entanglement)
description: Create the antisymmetric singlet Bell state |Ψ-⟩ = (|01⟩ - |10⟩)/√2 using 2 qubit lines. Flip qubit 1 with X, prepare qubit 0 in |−⟩ with X then H, and apply CNOT from q0 to q1.

title: Quantum Teleportation EPR Channel
description: Build an entangled Bell pair between qubit 1 and qubit 2 for a quantum teleportation channel. Using 3 qubit lines, apply H to qubit 1, then CNOT with control on qubit 1 and target on qubit 2.

title: 4-Qubit GHZ Cascade Entanglement
description: Scale entanglement up to 4 qubits to create (|0000⟩ + |1111⟩)/√2 across 4 qubit lines! Apply H to qubit 0, then cascade CNOT gates: q0 controls q1, q1 controls q2, and q2 controls q3.

title: Reverse-Controlled Entanglement
description: Create a Bell pair where qubit 1 is the control qubit. Using 2 qubit lines, apply H to qubit 1, then apply CNOT with control on qubit 1 and target on qubit 0.

title: Star Topology Entanglement
description: Create a star entanglement network where central qubit 1 is entangled with both outer qubits 0 and 2. Using 3 qubit lines, apply H to qubit 1, then CNOT from q1 to q0 and CNOT from q1 to q2.

title: Entanglement Swapping Pair Setup
description: Prepare two independent entangled Bell pairs across 4 qubit lines: pair A on (q0, q1) and pair B on (q2, q3). Apply H on q0, CNOT(0,1), H on q2, and CNOT(2,3).

title: Controlled-Z (CZ) Graph State
description: Construct entanglement using the Controlled-Z (CZ) gate. Apply H on qubit 0, H on qubit 1, then apply CZ with control on q0 and target on q1 to produce the 2-qubit cluster state (|00⟩ + |01⟩ + |10⟩ - |11⟩)/2.

title: SWAP Entangled Qubit Relay
description: Entangle qubits 0 and 1 into a Bell pair with H on q0 and CNOT(0, 1), then swap qubit 1 with qubit 2 using a SWAP gate so entanglement transfers between qubit 0 and qubit 2.

title: 3-Qubit Ring Entanglement
description: Form a closed 3-qubit entanglement ring across 3 lines. Apply H on qubit 0, CNOT(0, 1), CNOT(1, 2), and close the cyclic correlation with CNOT(2, 0).

title: Toffoli (CCX) Entanglement Trigger
description: Use a 3-qubit Toffoli (CCX) gate to conditionally entangle qubit 2 when both control qubits are in superposition! Apply H on qubit 0, H on qubit 1, then CCX(0, 1, 2).

title: Phase-Shifted Bell State
description: Create the complex phase-shifted Bell state (|00⟩ + i|11⟩)/√2 across 2 lines. First create a Bell pair with H on q0 and CNOT(0, 1), then apply the S gate on qubit 1 to add a relative phase of π/2.

title: 3-Qubit Entanglement Network
description: Build an open 3-party entangled quantum network across 3 lines. Put qubit 0 into superposition with H, entangle with qubit 1 via CNOT(0,1), then propagate to qubit 2 via CNOT(1,2).

title: W-State Core Entanglement
description: Create a 3-qubit entangled superposition across 3 lines. Place qubit 0 in superposition with H, entangle with qubit 1 via CNOT(0,1), and propagate to qubit 2 via CNOT(1,2).

title: 3-Qubit Linear Cluster State (CZ Chain)
description: Build a 3-qubit 1D cluster state using Controlled-Z gates across 3 lines. Apply H on all three qubits (0, 1, 2), then apply CZ between (q0, q1) and CZ between (q1, q2).

title: Entangled Parity Ancilla Measurement
description: Create an entangled Bell pair on qubits 0 and 1 with H(0) and CNOT(0,1), then entangle ancilla qubit 2 with both qubits using CNOT(0,2) and CNOT(1,2) to check even parity.

title: Dual Bell State Teleportation Relay
description: Prepare two separate Bell pairs across 4 lines: Bell(q0, q1) with H(0) and CNOT(0,1), and Bell(q2, q3) with H(2) and CNOT(2,3). Then couple them with CNOT(1,2) to start a quantum repeater relay.

title: Controlled-Z Phase Entanglement
description: Prepare qubit 0 in |+⟩ with H and flip qubit 1 to |1⟩ with X. Then apply CZ(0,1) and finally H on qubit 1 to generate maximal entanglement between the two lines.

title: 4-Qubit Cyclic Entanglement Ring
description: Create a 4-qubit cyclic entanglement ring across 4 lines. Put qubit 0 in superposition with H, entangle sequentially with CNOT(0,1), CNOT(1,2), CNOT(2,3), and close the ring with CNOT(3,0).

title: Deutsch's Algorithm (Balanced Oracle)
description: Implement Deutsch's algorithm to determine if a function is constant or balanced in a single evaluation! Prepare q0 in |+⟩ with H, ancilla q1 in |−⟩ with X then H. Apply the balanced oracle CNOT(0,1), then apply H on q0 to read the answer.

title: Superdense Coding Protocol
description: Transmit two classical bits ('11') using a single entangled qubit! First entangle q0 and q1 with H(0) and CNOT(0,1). Alice encodes message '11' with X(0) then Z(0). Bob decodes by applying CNOT(0,1) then H(0).

title: Phase Kickback Mechanism
description: Demonstrate quantum phase kickback! Prepare target qubit 1 in |−⟩ with X then H, control qubit 0 in |+⟩ with H. Apply CNOT(0,1) to kick the phase back to q0, then apply H on q0 to detect the kickback.

title: Quantum Half-Adder Circuit
description: Build a quantum half-adder to compute sum and carry! Put qubits 0 and 1 into superposition with H, compute the carry bit on qubit 2 using Toffoli CCX(0,1,2), and compute the modulo-2 sum on qubit 1 using CNOT(0,1).

title: 2-Qubit Quantum Fourier Transform
description: Implement the 2-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT). First apply H on qubit 0, apply Controlled-Z CZ(1,0), apply H on qubit 1, and finish with a SWAP(0,1) gate.

title: 2-Qubit Grover's Search Diffusion
description: Construct the Grover diffusion operator (inversion about the mean) for 2 qubits. Apply H on both qubits, X on both, Controlled-Z CZ(0,1), X on both, and finally H on both qubits.

title: Optimize Circuit Depth
description: Write code to construct a 3-qubit circuit that prepares a maximally entangled GHZ state (|000⟩ + |111⟩)/√2 while maintaining a circuit depth of under 4 layers. Output the circuit in your selected framework (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, or OpenQASM).

title: Quantum Error Correction 3-Qubit Code
description: Implement the 3-qubit bit-flip error correction encoding and parity syndrome extraction using 2 ancilla qubits. Protect state |ψ⟩ = α|0⟩ + β|1⟩ across 5 lines.

title: Deutsch-Jozsa Multi-Qubit Algorithm
description: Implement the full Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm for a 2-bit balanced oracle. Initialize input qubits 0 and 1 in superposition, ancilla qubit 2 in |−⟩, apply the balanced oracle f(x0, x1) = x0 ⊕ x1, and apply Hadamard on input qubits to determine whether f is constant or balanced in one evaluation.

title: Bernstein-Vazirani Bitstring Extraction
description: Implement the Bernstein-Vazirani algorithm to extract the hidden secret bitstring s = '101' in exactly ONE quantum query! Qubits 0, 1, 2 are query qubits; qubit 3 is the phase kickback ancilla. Demonstrate exponential query advantage over classical search.

title: Quantum Teleportation Full Protocol
description: Write a complete quantum teleportation protocol in your chosen framework. Prepare unknown state on q0, Bell state on q1 & q2, perform Bell measurement between q0 and q1, and apply conditional Pauli X and Z corrections on q2.

title: Quantum Phase Estimation (3-Qubit)
description: Implement 3-qubit Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) using 2 counting qubits and 1 target qubit. Initialize counting register in superposition, apply controlled-phase operations for the unitary U = S, and execute inverse QFT to readout the phase θ = 1/4.

title: W-State Multipartite Entanglement
description: Prepare the tripartite entangled W-state |W⟩ = (|100⟩ + |010⟩ + |001⟩)/√3 across 3 qubits. The W-state retains bipartite entanglement even when any single qubit is traced out or lost.

title: Quantum Superdense Coding Protocol
description: Implement the complete Superdense Coding protocol. Alice and Bob share an entangled Bell pair. Alice encodes 2 classical bits into her single qubit using Pauli operations, sends it to Bob, and Bob recovers both bits via Bell measurement.

title: Reversible Quantum Full Adder
description: Construct a reversible 1-bit quantum full adder using Toffoli (CCX) and CNOT gates across 4 qubits. Calculate both the sum bit |s⟩ = |a ⊕ b ⊕ cin⟩ and carry-out bit |cout⟩ without destroying input states.

title: Swap Test (Quantum State Overlap)
description: Implement the Swap Test algorithm to measure the state overlap |⟨ψ|φ⟩|² between two quantum states without full quantum state tomography. Uses an ancilla qubit controlling a Fredkin (CSWAP) gate followed by Hadamard readout.

title: Shor's Modular Multiplier Circuit
description: Synthesize the reversible modular multiplication circuit for a^x mod 15 (a = 7) used in Shor's factoring algorithm. Utilize controlled-SWAP networks to execute modular permutations on the 3-qubit work register.

title: Quantum Fourier Transform (3 Qubits)
description: Implement the 3-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) from scratch using Hadamard gates, controlled phase rotations (CZ / CP), and terminal SWAP gates to reverse qubit order.

title: Grover's Search Algorithm (Full 3-Qubit)
description: Build the complete Grover's search algorithm marking the target state |101⟩. Construct the oracle and the n-qubit diffusion operator (inversion about the mean) to achieve quadratic speedup.

title: Simon's XOR Periodicity Oracle
description: Implement Simon's algorithm for finding the hidden XOR mask s = '11' of a 2-to-1 function. Prepare input register in equal superposition, evaluate oracle with CNOTs, and measure in Hadamard basis to solve in polynomial time.

title: VQE Parameterized Quantum Ansatz
description: Construct a Hardware-Efficient Parameterized Quantum Circuit (Ansatz) for Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE). Combine single-qubit Ry rotations with entangling CNOT gates for molecular ground-state estimation.

title: 3-Qubit Bit-Flip Syndrome Extraction
description: Implement the syndrome measurement circuit for the 3-qubit bit-flip code using two ancilla qubits to identify error locations without collapsing the superposition state.

title: QAOA Max-Cut Quantum Ansatz (4 Qubits)
description: Construct a 1-layer QAOA (Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm) circuit for the Max-Cut problem on a 4-vertex cycle graph. Implement the cost Hamiltonian using ZZ interactions and mixer Hamiltonian using single-qubit Rx rotations.

title: Shor's 9-Qubit Quantum Error Correcting Code
description: Construct the full 9-qubit Shor Code encoding circuit. Concatenates the 3-qubit phase-flip code with 3-qubit bit-flip codes to protect a logical qubit against arbitrary single-qubit quantum errors.

title: Trotter-Suzuki Hamiltonian Simulation
description: Simulate time evolution under the 1D transverse-field Ising model H = -J ∑ Zi Z_{i+1} - h ∑ Xi using first-order Trotter-Suzuki decomposition. Interleave two-qubit ZZ interactions with transverse X magnetic field rotations.

title: Quantum Amplitude Amplification Operator
description: Build the generalized amplitude amplification operator Q = -A S0 A† Sχ on 4 qubits. Synthesize the reflection operator S0 and target phase oracle Sχ to amplify the amplitude of marked basis states.

title: Discrete Coined Quantum Walk (4 Qubits)
description: Implement a discrete-time quantum walk on a 3-qubit cyclic graph with a 1-qubit quantum coin. Apply Hadamard coin tossing followed by coin-controlled conditional shift operators.

title: Quantum Neural Network Entangling Layer
description: Construct a strongly entangling quantum circuit layer for a Quantum Neural Network (QNN) or Quantum Classifier on 4 qubits. Features arbitrary single-qubit Euler rotations followed by circular entangling CNOT gates.
